title: Byakugan
body:
Syntax: byakugan [on|off|status|scan <direction>]

Minimum level 25, Byakugan mastery 0% and inherited Potential 0 or higher. This toggles Byakugan or a short-lived defensive/celestial form. Higher modes have higher chakra upkeep. See 'help hyuga' for full bloodline rules. A technique only becomes available when level, mastery, and the character's permanent bloodline potential all qualify.
